verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows Snyk offering an explicit control or policy commitment letting users opt out of having their code/data used to train AI models; the only related evidence is a community complaint that Snyk's terms grant broad, perpetual license to uploaded repository content, which if anything argues against user control over data use. missing for 10: any documented opt-out/DPA clause, admin toggle, or public statement excluding customer code from AI-model training.
